facts.statement: The entry checks an eight-byte PNG signature, reads from the remaining input through a buffer callback, then calls png_read_info, png_read_update_info, png_set_interlace_handling, png_start_read_image, png_read_row in a passes-by-height loop, and png_read_end.

The supplied recipe edits pnglibconf.dfa to disable STDIO, WARNING, and WRITE, runs configure without listed options, builds libpng16.la, and links the fuzzer with libpng16.a and zlib. These lines do not establish the effective interlacing setting.

The input IHDR supplies the interlace type stored in png_ptr->interlaced. After reading IHDR, the harness rejects images only when height exceeds 100000000/width; it does not reject Adam7 by interlace type.

evidence.dependency_reason: The harness obtains the input's interlace type and applies its dimension gate before row reading.

facts.statement: In the before source, png_read_start_row sets Adam7 num_rows to the first pass's row count when PNG_INTERLACE is unset, or to the full image height when it is set; it sets PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT at the end.
In the after source, png_read_start_row retains the same Adam7 num_rows choice based on the current PNG_INTERLACE transformation bit and sets PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT at the end.

For subsequent Adam7 passes, png_read_finish_row recalculates num_rows from pass geometry when PNG_INTERLACE is unset, but leaves that count alone when the bit is set. Thus changing the bit after an earlier row initialization could affect whether the stored count matches the harness's full-height loop; the late setter's actual effect is not supplied.

evidence.dependency_reason: The harness calls png_read_row once per full image row on every returned pass.

facts.statement: png_start_read_image itself initializes rows only when PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT is clear; otherwise it calls png_app_error for a duplicate call. The supplied lines do not show whether png_read_update_info has already set that flag or what png_app_error does in this build.

evidence.dependency_reason: The harness places png_start_read_image after png_read_update_info and the interlace setter.

facts.statement: The source distinguishes a route without png_set_interlace_handling: it copies unexpanded interlace-pass rows. A supplied library test uses pass-specific width and row predicates to read such rows. That test's call sequence does not establish an equivalent route in this harness, whose loop reads every image row on each returned pass.

evidence.dependency_reason: The test demonstrates the alternate pass-specific sequential call pattern.
The target's fixed loop uses full-height rows for every pass.

facts.statement: The complete harness entry contains early-return checks and setjmp recovery, but no assert invocation or explicit check of decoded row contents or pass counts.
